name: Session Review
description: A "Review changes" action in each session's header opens a panel showing what that session changed: a tree of changed files on the left, and on the right one file at a time with old and new line numbers, coloured bands behind changed lines, and the changed words picked out within a replaced line. Untracked files are included, so what a session added is visible too. One click asks the session to review its own changes. Makes the cockpit a review station, not just a runner: the quality guard before an agent's output lands under your name. Requires git installed on the machine running Cockpit.
author: Cockpit
